entries: Protect from Goblin. Goblin make war with this. Make Goblin strong.
防哥布林。哥布林，拿它打仗。哥布林，会变强。
Female? Is warrior? How carry eggs, fight, same time?
雌的？还是战士？怎么一边背卵，一边打仗？
Not know about this. Why ask so many words? If human not know human word, why Scaphin know!?
不知道这个。为什么问这么多话？人类都不知道人类词，斯卡芬，怎么会知道！？
Ruin Scaphin! Is dead, but leave ruin! Must not drink of deep cave. It taste good. It tempt. It change. Must not drink.
毁了斯卡芬！他死了，可留下了祸害！千万别喝深洞里的水。它味道好。它诱人。它改变你。千万别喝。
Summjah... sometime cave wall have light, but this not what you speak. Something else?
苏姆贾……有时洞壁有光，但你说的不是这个。别的东西？
Goblin seek. All metal Goblin want, even no skill to make still want.
哥布林，要找。所有金属，哥布林，都想要——没本事打造，也照样想要。
Scaphin not want this, but # now see have value. Wish to understand this.
斯卡芬本不要这个，可 # 如今看出它有价值。想弄懂它。
Long time see. Many cycle not see. Maybe no more? Maybe hide from human like Scaphin. Human like take all for self. All can be like such. Even Scaphin.
许久不见。许多轮没见。也许再没有了？也许像斯卡芬，躲着人类。人类喜欢把一切都据为己有。谁都会这样。斯卡芬，也不例外。
Teach sounds. Want understand stick noise. Scaphin make noise too. *croak*
教声音。想懂棍子声。斯卡芬，也发声。*呱*
Summjah... self talk healthy? Not know. Talk anyways. Hello self.
苏姆贾……自言自语健康吗？不知道。总之说就是了。你好，自己。
Mind expand from thinking this. If new dimension, then more dimension not yet find?
想这个，脑袋会撑大。如果还有一个次元，那是不是还有没找到的次元？
Do not know. Do not care.
More cloth than others. Even his cloth wear cloth. Make it has sense!
布比别人多。连他的布都穿着布。让它有点道理！
You lead. Are king? Prince? How then you lead? Wish to understand new thing. Summjah...
你带队。是国王？是王子？那你怎么带队？想弄懂新东西。苏姆贾……
Thin wood stack not bring joy. But... near you... feel wood stack speak. Summjah...
薄薄的木头叠在一起，不让人开心。可……靠近你……感觉木头叠在说话。苏姆贾……
Is king son. One day king? King not think so. Me not think so. Want see world. Want sky not rocks only. Can such be king?
是国王的儿子。有一天会当国王？国王不这么想。我也不这么想。想看看世界。想看天空，不只有石头。这样也能当国王吗？
Humans collect dead. Put together, like family. Why? Scaphin use bone to keep family close. Make club, shield, spoon.
人类收集死者。摆在一起，像家人。为什么？斯卡芬用骨头，让家人不分离。做成棍子、盾、勺子。
Moist good. Humans not like moist? Keh? Is good for skin.
潮湿好。人类不喜欢潮湿？咳？对皮肤好。
Scaphin live side human for many cycle. Once enemy, then friend, then enemy. Always cycle. Maybe stay friend?
斯卡芬和人类做了许多轮的邻居。先当敌人，再当朋友，再当敌人。总是轮回。也许这次一直做朋友？
Caves home. Stay moist. Caves go deep. Never end of how deep. Can there be such thing as no end? Maybe cave end. Maybe not.
洞穴是家。保持潮湿。洞穴很深。深得没有尽头。真有无穷无尽这种说法吗？也许洞有尽头。也许没有。
Is above name? Want see not rock sky. Want see Emerisk. Is more than Emerisk? How far sky go?
上面有名字？想看不是岩石的天空。想看埃梅里斯克。比埃梅里斯克更多吗？天空能到多远？
You Renault? Renault friend? What this Renault? Who this Renault? Human name strange.
你是雷诺？雷诺，是朋友？这个雷诺，是什么？这个雷诺，是谁？人类名字真怪。
Animal is friend? This thing new.
Keh? Head grow ornament, like Scaphin... but... like horse?
咳？头上长了装饰，像斯卡芬……可……像马？
Gourah! You know this? Is dangerous. Seek only greed, destroy. Can Goblin ever good? Summjah...
咕啦！你认得它？它危险。只求贪欲，只会破坏。哥布林，能有好的一天吗？苏姆贾……
Saw enter spider lair. Unwise. Glad safe now.
看见你进了蜘蛛窝。不聪明。幸好现在平安。
